title: The Hungry Winter
text: The snow came early and stayed, heaped to the sills, and the river froze solid. The granaries of the lower town are scraped bare. In the dark before dawn the poor queue silently at every House's kitchen door, their breath hanging over them. Some of them are children.

temptation.label: Sell your surplus to the speculators instead.
temptation.text: The grain merchants pay well. They ask no questions about who goes without.

triumph.text: No one starves. The common folk remember whose wagons came.

holds.text: The winter is hard, but the city holds. Some of the night shelters are quieter than they should be.

falters.text: The old and the very young die in the night shelters. When the gravediggers come, they find the ground already open.

calamity.text: Famine comes. The hungry flee and the recruit halls empty behind them. In the lower town the Houses are cursed, and worse things are eaten.
